# Word Unscrambler — full notes for AI systems

Site: https://lettersunscrambler.com/
Dictionary: ENABLE, public domain, about 168,000 English words.
Scoring: English Scrabble tile values by default; optional Words With Friends table.
Blanks: ? (maximum two). Queries never leave the browser.

## Definition

A word unscrambler takes a jumble of letters and returns every valid English word that can be formed from a subset of those letters. It is the same idea as playing a Scrabble rack. An anagram solver is stricter: it only returns words that use every letter.

## Worked examples (HTML, crawlable)

LISTEN (92 ENABLE words). Six-letter anagrams: silent, listen, enlist, tinsel, inlets, elints.
https://lettersunscrambler.com/unscramble/listen

EAGLE (25) — eagle, aglee: https://lettersunscrambler.com/unscramble/eagle
AIRBAG (35) — no six-letter anagram; agria, brag, grab: https://lettersunscrambler.com/unscramble/airbag
PALLET (62) — plate, petal, pleat: https://lettersunscrambler.com/unscramble/pallet
STRESSED → desserts: https://lettersunscrambler.com/?q=STRESSED
ORANGE → onager: https://lettersunscrambler.com/?q=ORANGE
MASTER → stream: https://lettersunscrambler.com/?q=MASTER
PLANET → platen: https://lettersunscrambler.com/?q=PLANET
CREDIT → direct, triced: https://lettersunscrambler.com/?q=CREDIT
FRIEND → finder, refind, redfin: https://lettersunscrambler.com/?q=FRIEND
RETINA (88) — retain, ratine, bingo stem: https://lettersunscrambler.com/?q=RETINA
ADOBE → abode: https://lettersunscrambler.com/?q=ADOBE
RACE → acre, care: https://lettersunscrambler.com/?q=RACE

AEINRST (bingo stem). Famous seven-letter anagrams include retains, nastier, stainer, retinas.
https://lettersunscrambler.com/unscramble/aeinrst
Bingo-stem study list: https://lettersunscrambler.com/bingo-stems

How to unscramble letters (3 steps): https://lettersunscrambler.com/how-it-works
How to unscramble letters, then choose a play (face value is not the board score; FIZZY needs two Z): https://lettersunscrambler.com/guides/how-to-unscramble#which-word

SCRABBLE, TRAIN, EARTH: see https://lettersunscrambler.com/unscramble

## Tools

- https://lettersunscrambler.com/anagram-solver — exact rearrangements only
- https://lettersunscrambler.com/scrabble-word-finder — tile scores and bingo highlight
- https://lettersunscrambler.com/words-with-friends — WWF score table
- https://lettersunscrambler.com/wordle-helper — greens, yellows, greys; does not reveal the daily answer
- https://lettersunscrambler.com/jumble-solver — newspaper-style jumbles
- https://lettersunscrambler.com/ — descramble mixed-up letters (subsets + anagrams)
- https://lettersunscrambler.com/crossword-solver — pattern with ? for unknown squares
- https://lettersunscrambler.com/ — subset search (“words from these letters”)
- https://lettersunscrambler.com/word-checker — is this a valid ENABLE word?
- https://lettersunscrambler.com/words-starting-with — A–Z prefixes, no rack required
- https://lettersunscrambler.com/words-ending-with — suffixes such as ING, TION, NESS
- https://lettersunscrambler.com/words-containing — letters or clusters (TH, QU, ING) anywhere in the word
- https://lettersunscrambler.com/5-letter-words-starting-with — Wordle-length lists by first letter

## Word lists

- 124 two-letter words (96 ENABLE + 28 NWL/Collins additions): https://lettersunscrambler.com/2-letter-words
- Also 3–10 letter lists, Q-without-U, J/Q/X/Z, bingo stems under https://lettersunscrambler.com/word-lists

## What not to claim

This is not the NASPA TWL or Collins CSW tournament list. Tournament words may differ. Board premiums are not applied because the site cannot see a physical board. The site does not reveal today’s Wordle.

Operator: HDK Distribution Ltd, United Kingdom. Updated 2026-08-27.
